description: Prefer MCP tools for reasoning, docs lookup, memory, and web retrieval.

- Look up library and framework APIs with Context7 before relying on memory.
- Use sequential thinking for non-trivial debugging, design, and multi-step plans.
- Use the memory MCP for durable repo facts; use fetch for web retrieval.
- Use plain shell tools only when no MCP fits or the MCP fails; say why.
